title: Just 300 Gold Short of a New Backpack | Stardew Valley Reward Design

scenes.title: 끝내려는데, 딱 조금이 남았다
lines: I was about to stop for the day, but I only needed three hundred more gold for a bigger backpack.
Well, I could just earn that little bit more, right? And there goes another day on the farm. I was trying to clock out, but the backpack had other plans.
The first backpack upgrade in Stardew Valley costs two thousand gold. If we imagine having seventeen hundred, an abstract purchase becomes a goal of earning three hundred more.
The important part is not that the reward is enormous. It is knowing what I can get and how close I am to getting it.
